method: 3 baseline runs per task, harness=a (frozen baseline), opencode 1.15.13, deepseek-v4-flash, build agent, reasoning high, timeout 480s

assessment.ceiling_effect: 22/23 tasks at 100% verified success. DeepSeek V4 Flash + opencode build solves all conventional single/multi-module bug-fix, refactor, state-sequence, cross-file contract, exception-contract, sorting-stability, invariant and boundary-semantics tasks within 60s (t-020 refactor: 131-249s but solved). The 60-85% harness-recoverable zone is EMPTY on this task family.
assessment.t-008_anomaly: 0/3 verified; ALL THREE runs TIMEOUT at 480s with ZERO edits. The agent enters a research/exploration loop (searches old /tmp artifacts in r1, inspects bytecode, cache files) and never performs an edit. Boundary-condition bugs (strict vs non-strict interval comparisons at two sites) are not discovered. Attempts to replicate this failure class on other domains (t-021 half-open intervals, t-022 reversed comparisons, t-023 inclusive end) were ALL SOLVED at 100% — so the failure is NOT the boundary-semantics class per se, but something task-specific about t-008 (merged-interval + two hidden boundary sites + README phrasing).
assessment.harness_recoverable_zone: EMPTY — no task with baseline success in 20-90%.
assessment.weakness_mining_implication: Only reproducible failure: t-008 research-loop (3/3 runs, 0 edits). Weakness observed on 1 distinct task only; cross-task replication failed by design probes t-021/022/023. Candidate justification threshold (>=2 runs) met; cross-task requirement (preferred) NOT met.
assessment.action_taken: Proceed with formal splits, baseline freeze, trajectory summary from calibration runs (70 baseline trajectories), weakness analysis, then candidate-gate decision.
